auth_meta_description: Sign in to Zurvann with your mobile number to request a free evaluation and follow your dog's training.
auth_welcome_note: First time here? Your account is created right here.
auth_step_code_title: Tell me the code from the text
auth_scene_phone: Hi! Give me your number so I know who you are.
auth_scene_password: Tell me your password; no need to wait for a text.
auth_scene_code: Did the text arrive? Tell me the 5-digit code.
auth_scene_name: Now tell me your name. I want to call you by it.
auth_phone_note: We'll text the sign-in code to this number.
auth_phone_invalid: That mobile number isn't valid. Example: 09123456789
auth_code_incomplete: Enter the full 5-digit code from the text.
auth_code_demo: Demo version: the sign-in code is always {code}. Tap it to fill it in.
auth_password_via_code: Sign in with a text code
auth_name_intro: Your account is ready. Enter your name so the trainer knows who they're working with.
auth_name_rules_missing: You need to accept the rules to continue.
auth_name_rules_failed: The rules weren't recorded. Please try again.
auth_trust_title: We keep your number only to work with you.
auth_trust_body: For signing in and for the texts about your dog's training. If a partner brought you here, they only see that you signed up and bought.
auth_demo_note: Pick one; the sign-in code for all of them is {code}.
auth_error_invalid_otp: That code isn't right. Check it and enter it again.
auth_error_otp_expired: This code is no longer valid. Get a new one.
auth_error_too_many_attempts: Too many wrong codes were entered. Get a new code.
auth_error_resend_too_soon: The last code was just sent. Wait a minute and ask again.
auth_error_too_many_codes: Too many codes were sent to this number in the last hour. Try again a little later.
auth_error_blocked: This account is blocked. Contact Zurvann to follow up.
auth_error_sign_in_paused: Too many wrong passwords were entered. Wait a few minutes, or sign in with a text code.
auth_error_too_many_requests: There were too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
auth_error_wrong_credentials: The number or password isn't right. If you haven't set a password, sign in with a text code.
auth_error_general: That didn't go through. Check your internet connection and try again.
